properties.name: pos.events.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the pos-events/event-receiver API.

properties.name: pos.events.api-secret
properties.description: Shared secret used to authenticate event type registration requests.

properties.name: pos.security.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for permission registration against pos-security-service.

properties.name: pos.security.permission-registration.enabled
properties.description: Enable startup permission registration with pos-security-service.

properties.name: pos.warranty.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Enable domain-event publishing via the transactional outbox to Kafka (ADR-0044).

properties.name: pos.warranty.outbox.poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Delay between outbox drain polls in milliseconds.

properties.name: pos.warranty.outbox.send-timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout for a single blocking Kafka send from the outbox drain, in milliseconds.
